in_sanskrit.name: सत्यव्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is brave in truth or upholds truth with bravery

in_marathi.name: Satyavr
in_marathi.long_meaning: Satyavr हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Satyavr is derived from two words - 'Satya' meaning truth and 'Vr' meaning guardian.
